{{Quote|Look, I'm tellin' you nothin's out there. Sensors show nothing. You haven't been dipping into my stash of Wroonian ale, have you?|Roark Garnet to Selnia Harbright|<ref name="VT" />}}
'''Wroonian ale''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Ale/Legends|beverage]] produced by the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonians]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] kept a stash of Wroonian ale aboard his ship, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]''.<ref name="VT" />
